verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents official SDKs for building against this GPU. The CUDA Toolkit ships GPU-accelerated libraries, a C/C++ compiler, a runtime, and debugging and optimization tools (Nsight). cuTile Python and CUDA Tile C++ add tile programming, and NGC containers, the RTX Neural Shaders SDK and support for PyTorch and TensorFlow round it out. Phoronix's 60+ CUDA/OptiX/OpenCL/Vulkan benchmarks on the 5090 confirm the SDK stack runs on this card. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation tying specific SDK versions to RTX 5090/Blackwell support, and independent hands-on reports of developing against the SDKs rather than just benchmarking with them.
